title: Illustration as an agent
description:
Definition for `illustrate`: woken when a Story's Illustration step becomes ready or an illustration Assignment is created; reads the site's image style profile; makes one image unattended; never places a third-party image without credit; cost on the ledger.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A ready Illustration step gets a candidate without a person.
- Rules on alt text and credit are enforced by the gate.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- illustration-agent.feature: a ready step produces one candidate; at `prepare` a person chooses; at `publish_auto` the candidate is placed if every check passes.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Every other responsibility as an agent. Slice code M5 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
